narrator-1gxg69inv0v.speaker: narrator
narrator-1gxg69inv0v.text: Long ago, the world was a lit hall. The Lanternwrights, who kept its lamps, called it Halcyre.
narrator-1gxg69inv0v.heard: Long ago, the world was a lit hall. The Lanternwrights, who kept its lamps, called it Halcyre.

narrator-2ayiz76hmcf.speaker: narrator
narrator-2ayiz76hmcf.text: They held its wild magic still with one great working: the Song.
narrator-2ayiz76hmcf.heard: They held its wild magic still with one great working, the Song.

narrator-yxp39fcwfe.speaker: narrator
narrator-yxp39fcwfe.text: Then the Song broke. Nobody alive knows why. The lamps went out, one by one.
narrator-yxp39fcwfe.heard: Then the song broke. Nobody alive knows why. The lamps went out one by one.

narrator-14lfalnuqpu.speaker: narrator
narrator-14lfalnuqpu.text: The magic spilled. Now it moves over the open land like weather, and people call it the Drift.
narrator-14lfalnuqpu.heard: The magic spilled. Now it moves over the open land like weather, and people call it the Drift.

narrator-gkmxa8qikr.speaker: narrator
narrator-gkmxa8qikr.text: Glimmer, that turns the lamps blue. The grey, that makes a village forget itself. Hollow wind. Brightfall.
narrator-gkmxa8qikr.heard: Glimmer, that turns the lamps blue. The grey that makes a village forget itself. Hollowwind, Brightfall.

narrator-kxujefdi1x.speaker: narrator
narrator-kxujefdi1x.text: So people live inside wards: small villages gathered round the old stones that still hum. Every village is a lamp in a large, dark room.
narrator-kxujefdi1x.heard: So people live inside wards, small villages gathered round the old stones that still hum. Every village is a lamp in a large dark room.

narrator-1pe1jtmyz94.speaker: narrator
narrator-1pe1jtmyz94.text: This is Hearthvale. A kettle-fire that has never once gone out, and a singing stone at the bottom of the well: the Wellstone.
narrator-1pe1jtmyz94.heard: This is Hearthvale, a kettlefire that has never once gone out and a singing stone at the bottom of the well, the Wellstone.

narrator-ep97j18f5x.speaker: narrator
narrator-ep97j18f5x.text: Every household keeps one flame on the chapel altar, and the flames hold the ward up.
narrator-ep97j18f5x.heard: Every household keeps one flame on the Chapel Altar, and the flames hold the ward up.

narrator-t8y7gu9aj9.speaker: narrator
narrator-t8y7gu9aj9.text: Twenty-five winters ago, for eleven still nights, light fell on the valley like snow.
narrator-t8y7gu9aj9.heard: 25 winters ago for 11 still nights, light fell on the valley like snow.

narrator-22kf09bwctr.speaker: narrator
narrator-22kf09bwctr.text: By midsummer, old Hobb the lamplighter and Wenna the beekeeper, long past hope of children, had a daughter. They named her for a star: Lyra.
narrator-22kf09bwctr.heard: By midsummer, old Hobb the lamplighter and Wenna the beekeeper, long past hope of children, had a daughter. They named her for a star, Lyra.

narrator-1kbl0176ica.speaker: narrator
narrator-1kbl0176ica.text: The old women counted on their fingers, and said nothing out loud.
narrator-1kbl0176ica.heard: The old women counted on their fingers and said nothing out loud.

narrator-1ljomh3ah9c.speaker: narrator
narrator-1ljomh3ah9c.text: Maren Ashgrove, the village's wardwright, taught her magic for thirteen years.
narrator-1ljomh3ah9c.heard: Maren Ashgrove, the village's wardrite, taught her magic for 13 years.

narrator-wjqsb0pu7n.speaker: narrator
narrator-wjqsb0pu7n.text: Three months ago, on Lyra's birthday, Maren went over the wall of the Sunken Ruins with a lantern and a rope, and did not come back.
narrator-wjqsb0pu7n.heard: Three months ago on Lyra's birthday, Maren went over the wall of the sunken ruins with a lantern and a rope and did not come back.

narrator-2bqybcyq2md.speaker: narrator
narrator-2bqybcyq2md.text: Maren’s notes called the stone ring on the Hollowcrown “the other end”. Lyra paid Hess the wardrunner to take her up.
narrator-2bqybcyq2md.heard: Maren's notes called the Stone Ring on the Hollowcrown, the Other End. Lyra paid Hess the Wardweller to take her up.

lyra-28qcq7ps47y.speaker: lyra
lyra-28qcq7ps47y.text: If she went anywhere, she went up there.
lyra-28qcq7ps47y.heard: If she went anywhere, she went up there.

narrator-stifbteap3.speaker: narrator
narrator-stifbteap3.text: At dawn they reached the Crown Ring: nine broken stones in the snow.
narrator-stifbteap3.heard: At dawn they reached the crown ring, nine broken stones in the snow.

narrator-1pwh7i158ne.speaker: narrator
narrator-1pwh7i158ne.text: In the middle, the snow had melted in a perfect circle. No footprints in. None out.
narrator-1pwh7i158ne.heard: In the middle, the snow had melted in a perfect circle. No footprints in, none out.

narrator-25zmebpylpv.speaker: narrator
narrator-25zmebpylpv.text: And in it lay someone. Warm. Breathing. A sword beside them.
narrator-25zmebpylpv.heard: And in it lay someone, warm, breathing, a sword beside them.

lyra-16aowks7kgh.speaker: lyra
lyra-16aowks7kgh.text: Loosely. We're not leaving a living person up here.
lyra-16aowks7kgh.heard: Loosely, we're not leaving a living person up here.

narrator-1ts18or7r1f.speaker: narrator
narrator-1ts18or7r1f.text: They carried you down on a litter made of Lyra's cloak. When you passed the well, the Wellstone hummed for the whole square to hear.
narrator-1ts18or7r1f.heard: They carried you down on a litter made of Lyra's cloak. When you passed the well, the Wellstone hummed for the whole square to hear.

narrator-v62rcub1ef.speaker: narrator
narrator-v62rcub1ef.text: You slept in the chapel for eighty-one nights. Six days ago you woke, remembering nothing.
narrator-v62rcub1ef.heard: You slept in the chapel for 81 nights. Six days ago you woke, remembering nothing.

narrator-13advyz61m7.speaker: narrator
narrator-13advyz61m7.text: Two days ago, on the King's Road, wolves came at dusk. You stood beside her.
narrator-13advyz61m7.heard: Two days ago, on the King's Road, wolves came at dusk. You stood beside her.

lyra-36cwwsp43u.speaker: lyra
lyra-36cwwsp43u.text: Morning. Still breathing? Good. I'd hate to have carried you down a mountain for nothing.
lyra-36cwwsp43u.heard: Morning. Still breathing? Good. I'd hate to have carried you down a mountain for nothing.

lyra-17gkb9z35yy.speaker: lyra
lyra-17gkb9z35yy.text: In case the mountain took this too: I'm Lyra Ambrel. This is the Wayhouse, in Hearthvale.
lyra-17gkb9z35yy.heard: In case the mountain took this too, I'm Lyra Ambrel. This is the Wayhouse in Hearthvale.

lyra-rct9txipve.speaker: lyra
lyra-rct9txipve.text: I hold your key. That’s the hearthwatch: I look in, I sleep in the spare bed when I feel like it, and the Moot pays me.
lyra-rct9txipve.heard: I hold your key. That's the Hearthwatch. I look in, I sleep in the spare bed when I feel like it, and the Moot pays me.

lyra-23sk590fiy4.speaker: lyra
lyra-23sk590fiy4.text: Nobody's obliged to keep one. I took yours because I wanted to.
lyra-23sk590fiy4.heard: Nobody's obliged to keep one. I took yours because I wanted to.

lyra-28m0qgdbt4r.speaker: lyra
lyra-28m0qgdbt4r.text: Now. Breakfast at the Kettle, and you tell me if anything's come back. Even something small.
lyra-28m0qgdbt4r.heard: Now! Breakfast at the Kettle, and you tell me if anything's come back. Even something small?

wenna-1e25pcwttwo.speaker: wenna
wenna-1e25pcwttwo.text: Who's that? Come here, let me hear you.
wenna-1e25pcwttwo.heard: Who's that? Come here, let me hear you.

lyra-20rt2s09p8z.speaker: lyra
lyra-20rt2s09p8z.text: Mam. It's the one off the mountain. You asked to meet them.
lyra-20rt2s09p8z.heard: Ma 'am, it's the one off the mountain, you asked to meet them.

wenna-1xu2afkr8ga.speaker: wenna
wenna-1xu2afkr8ga.text: I did. My eyes are no use past my own hand, so you'll have to bend down. Hold still.
wenna-1xu2afkr8ga.heard: I did. My eyes are no use past my own hand, so you'll have to bend down. Hold still.

narrator-1i0ugacp9cf.speaker: narrator
narrator-1i0ugacp9cf.text: Her hands are cool and dry, and smell of beeswax. She reads your face the way she reads her hives: slowly, and missing nothing.
narrator-1i0ugacp9cf.heard: Her hands are cool and dry, and smell of beeswax. She reads your face the way she reads her hives, slowly and missing nothing.

wenna-18k05gcx3ou.speaker: wenna
wenna-18k05gcx3ou.text: Hm. Young. Tired. Not a liar's jaw.
wenna-18k05gcx3ou.heard: Hmm, young, tired, not a liar's jaw.

wenna-2dio7ipu4tg.speaker: wenna
wenna-2dio7ipu4tg.text: The mountain gives and the mountain takes, and it never gives for nothing. Mind you're worth what it took.
wenna-2dio7ipu4tg.heard: The mountain gives and the mountain takes, and it never gives for nothing. Mind, you're worth what it took.

hobb-1z35kk0fjnm.speaker: hobb
hobb-1z35kk0fjnm.text: Well now. Look who's up and walking.
hobb-1z35kk0fjnm.heard: Well, now, look who's up and walking.

hobb-xvn3w9zry7.speaker: hobb
hobb-xvn3w9zry7.text: Everyone found deserves a lamp. I hung one by your door. Mind the cat doesn't sit in it.
hobb-xvn3w9zry7.heard: Everyone found deserves a lamp. I hung one by your door. Mind the cat doesn't sit in it.

lyra-17ucx1sbfkp.speaker: lyra
lyra-17ucx1sbfkp.text: Da. Your spectacles are on your head.
lyra-17ucx1sbfkp.heard: Da, your spectacles are on your head.

hobb-p1otw7ev2m.speaker: hobb
hobb-p1otw7ev2m.text: Are they? Well now. So they are.
hobb-p1otw7ev2m.heard: Are they? Well now. So they are.

wenna-1pngqd2yl4q.speaker: wenna
wenna-1pngqd2yl4q.text: Bring them to supper, Lyra Ambrel. I want to hear them eat.
wenna-1pngqd2yl4q.heard: Bring them to supper, Lyra Ambrel. I want to hear them eat.

narrator-uhlchep2x8.speaker: narrator
narrator-uhlchep2x8.text: Thirty-eight flames burn on the altar: one for every household under the ward.
narrator-uhlchep2x8.heard: Thirty -eight flames burn on the altar, one for every household under the ward.

narrator-18j61hduog2.speaker: narrator
narrator-18j61hduog2.text: As you come near, every one of them leans toward you, the way a flower leans to a window.
narrator-18j61hduog2.heard: As you come near, every one of them leans towards you, the way a flower leans to a window.

aveline-1j1fd5zi6k0.speaker: aveline
aveline-1j1fd5zi6k0.text: They do that. They did it every night you slept here, child.
aveline-1j1fd5zi6k0.heard: They do that. They did it every night you slept here, child.

aveline-12fkvqm59dx.speaker: aveline
aveline-12fkvqm59dx.text: A question someone has sent us. I have not found the answer. I have stopped minding.
aveline-12fkvqm59dx.heard: A question someone has sent us. I have not found the answer. I have stopped minding.

lyra-2fjw3891xud.speaker: lyra
lyra-2fjw3891xud.text: Don't look at me. I don't know why either. I've asked them.
lyra-2fjw3891xud.heard: Don't look at me. I don't know why either. I've asked them.

lyra-4jzx44ago8.speaker: lyra
lyra-4jzx44ago8.text: You keep watching my hands when I light a lamp. Want to know how it started? It's a short one.
lyra-4jzx44ago8.heard: You keep watching my hands when I light a lamp. Wanna know how it started? It's a short one.

lyra-11ywlmp1ayy.speaker: lyra
lyra-11ywlmp1ayy.text: Longwatch night. I was eleven. A hollow wind came down off the Crownfells and blew out every lamp on the square at once.
lyra-11ywlmp1ayy.heard: Long Watch Night. I was 11. A hollow wind came down off the crownfells and blew out every lamp on the square at once.

lyra-2g51742tt6.speaker: lyra
lyra-2g51742tt6.text: It knocked Da off his ladder onto the ice.
lyra-2g51742tt6.heard: It knocked Daa off his ladder onto the ice.

lyra-24rf0i06pj6.speaker: lyra
lyra-24rf0i06pj6.text: I was so frightened, and so angry, and so cold, that I lit them. All of them. At the same moment. In violet.
lyra-24rf0i06pj6.heard: I was so frightened, and so angry, and so cold, that I lit them, all of them, at the same moment, in violet.

lyra-riwldudpfu.speaker: lyra
lyra-riwldudpfu.text: One burst. Da sat up on the ice and said, ‘Well now.’
lyra-riwldudpfu.heard: One burst. Dass sat up on the ice and said, Well, now.

lyra-1v3hebyluys.speaker: lyra
lyra-1v3hebyluys.text: And Maren came out of the Kettle in her nightgown, looked at the lamps, looked at me, and said—
lyra-1v3hebyluys.heard: And Maren came out of the kettle in her nightgown, looked at the lamps, looked at me, and said,

maren-1gokyi67t9h.speaker: maren
maren-1gokyi67t9h.text: Well. There goes my quiet old age.
maren-1gokyi67t9h.heard: Well, there goes my quiet old age.

lyra-6sz4yy0j6v.speaker: lyra
lyra-6sz4yy0j6v.text: She took me on the next morning. I've been cold ever since. Worth it.
lyra-6sz4yy0j6v.heard: She took me on the next morning. I've been cold ever since. Worth it.

lyra-1bmteti47l4.speaker: lyra
lyra-1bmteti47l4.text: See the iron in the north face? Bram's stakes. The Moot sealed it five years ago. Because of me.
lyra-1bmteti47l4.heard: See the iron in the north face? Bram's steaks. The Moot sealed it five years ago, because of me.

lyra-558wd8wlve.speaker: lyra
lyra-558wd8wlve.text: Davin wanted coin for the Saltmere road-guard. The crystals in the Cut were the quickest coin in the valley. He asked me to come. A mage would make it safe.
lyra-558wd8wlve.heard: Davin wanted coin for the Saltmere Roadguard. The crystals in the cut were the quickest coin in the valley. He asked me to come. A mage would make it safe.

lyra-1j84gmh5esc.speaker: lyra
lyra-1j84gmh5esc.text: I could feel it stirring. I said no. He asked again. And again. Sweetly. He talked about the sea.
lyra-1j84gmh5esc.heard: I could feel it stirring. I said no. He asked again. And again, sweetly. He talked about the sea.

lyra-166yjw27ftr.speaker: lyra
lyra-166yjw27ftr.text: So I said yes. Not because I'd changed my mind. Because I didn't want to be the one who made his life small.
lyra-166yjw27ftr.heard: So I said yes, not because I'd changed my mind, because I didn't want to be the one who made his life small.

lyra-104h0eu878y.speaker: lyra
lyra-104h0eu878y.text: It woke around us. Slimes out of the walls. Something with too many bones. I cast until I guttered.
lyra-104h0eu878y.heard: It woke around us. Slimes out of the walls? Something with too many bones. I cast until I guttered.

lyra-1dld4sz9770.speaker: lyra
lyra-1dld4sz9770.text: Davin ran. For help, he said. Bryn dragged me out on her back, and in the last passage the stone came down on her leg.
lyra-1dld4sz9770.heard: Davin ran. For help, he said. Bryn dragged me out on her back, and in the last passage, the stone came down on her leg.

lyra-2ayt1ej9n6d.speaker: lyra
lyra-2ayt1ej9n6d.text: I lent warmth into it for three nights. It wasn't enough. She walks with a stick now, in Saltmere. She forgave me years ago.
lyra-2ayt1ej9n6d.heard: I lent warmth into it for three nights. It wasn't enough. She walks with a stick now in Saltmere. She forgave me years ago.

maren-vry4n8lrtk.speaker: maren
maren-vry4n8lrtk.text: You spent your judgment like a coin you didn't have. Never again go where you've already said no. For anyone. Not for him. Not for me.
maren-vry4n8lrtk.heard: You spent your judgment like a coin you didn't have. Never again go where you've already said no. For anyone. Not for him. Not for me.

lyra-1giy5mf9ijk.speaker: lyra
lyra-1giy5mf9ijk.text: So when I say no, that's why. It isn't about you. It's about the coin.
lyra-1giy5mf9ijk.heard: So when I say no, that's why it isn't about you, it's about the coin.

lyra-17poah1esr5.speaker: lyra
lyra-17poah1esr5.text: Sister. Tell them what you saw. At midsummer.
lyra-17poah1esr5.heard: Sister, tell them what you saw at Midsummer.

aveline-5z0aydqhc5.speaker: aveline
aveline-5z0aydqhc5.text: I saw her go, child. Dusk, on the longest day. Her grey cloak, a lantern, a coil of rope over her shoulder.
aveline-5z0aydqhc5.heard: I saw her go, child, dusk on the longest day, her gray cloak, a lantern, a coil of rope over her shoulder.

aveline-ely11mhxjp.speaker: aveline
aveline-ely11mhxjp.text: She walked down the road toward the marsh as if she were late for supper. I called after her.
aveline-ely11mhxjp.heard: She walked down the road toward the marsh as if she were late for supper. I called after her.

aveline-cttq4ywrca.speaker: aveline
aveline-cttq4ywrca.text: She raised her hand. She did not turn around.
aveline-cttq4ywrca.heard: She raised her hand. She did not turn around.

aveline-23o0u5sqmjx.speaker: aveline
aveline-23o0u5sqmjx.text: The blue lights began that night. I have prayed for her every dusk since. Prayer is mostly waiting, and waiting I can do.
aveline-23o0u5sqmjx.heard: The blue lights began that night. I have prayed for her every dusk since. Prayer is mostly waiting, and waiting I can do.

lyra-1ezlwyz504d.speaker: lyra
lyra-1ezlwyz504d.text: She paid a month ahead at the Kettle. She bought turnips, for a long walk. People who mean to die don't buy turnips.
lyra-1ezlwyz504d.heard: She paid a month ahead at the kettle. She bought turnips for a long walk. People who mean to die don't buy turnips.

lyra-5j16xoste7.speaker: lyra
lyra-5j16xoste7.text: This is as close as the Moot lets anyone come. Sealed by order of the chapel, a hundred and ten years ago.
lyra-5j16xoste7.heard: This is as close as the Moot lets anyone come, sealed by order of the chapel 110 years ago.

lyra-1j3devj6zrk.speaker: lyra
lyra-1j3devj6zrk.text: She didn't use the gate. She went over the low stretch of wall on the marsh side. It slumped into the marsh the same night.
lyra-1j3devj6zrk.heard: She didn't use the gate, she went over the low stretch of wall on the marsh side, it slumped into the marsh the same night.

lyra-eaey6eq1nr.speaker: lyra
lyra-eaey6eq1nr.text: I climbed the high wall once, alone, on Hess's rope. Something with no skin got hold of my boot.
lyra-eaey6eq1nr.heard: I climbed the highwall once, alone, on Hess's rope, something with no skin got hold of my boot.

lyra-11xz2bydc52.speaker: lyra
lyra-11xz2bydc52.text: I'm not going in again without the key. A gate's a way out you can run through. A rope isn't.
lyra-11xz2bydc52.heard: I'm not going in again without the Key. A gate's a way out. You can run through. A rope isn't.

lyra-1trec29uzf.speaker: lyra
lyra-1trec29uzf.text: The bandits have the key. So that is where it starts, if it starts.
lyra-1trec29uzf.heard: The bandits have the key, so that is where it starts, if it starts.

lyra-yf8nu65xds.speaker: lyra
lyra-yf8nu65xds.text: ‘If someone comes out, I hope whoever it is is kind.’
lyra-yf8nu65xds.heard: If someone comes out, I hope whoever it is is kind.

lyra-28ye0ltbm77.speaker: lyra
lyra-28ye0ltbm77.text: That's her hand. She wrote it before she went through.
lyra-28ye0ltbm77.heard: That's her hand. She wrote it before she went through.

lyra-17nsj6s7qbp.speaker: lyra
lyra-17nsj6s7qbp.text: Someone did come out. At the other end. Lying warm in the snow, with a sword.
lyra-17nsj6s7qbp.heard: Someone did come out at the other end, lying warm in the snow with a sword.

lyra-2epr5rkn8x2.speaker: lyra
lyra-2epr5rkn8x2.heard: Well, you'd better be kind then.

narrator-jigzxkejmo.speaker: narrator
narrator-jigzxkejmo.text: Light gathers between your hands out of nothing: no flame, no breath spent. For a heartbeat there are marks in it, sharp little shapes, there and gone.
narrator-jigzxkejmo.heard: Light gathers between your hands out of nothing, no flame, no breath spent. For a heartbeat, there are marks in it, sharp little shapes, there and gone.

lyra-1ho9pje20iu.speaker: lyra
lyra-1ho9pje20iu.text: That isn't a spark. I make sparks. I know what they cost me, every one.
lyra-1ho9pje20iu.heard: That isn't a spark. I make sparks. I know what they cost me, everyone.

lyra-2fc8q8ycsf1.speaker: lyra
lyra-2fc8q8ycsf1.text: Those marks. Maren used to copy marks like that off the ruins wall by candlelight. Lanternwright letters.
lyra-2fc8q8ycsf1.heard: Those marks. Maren used to copy marks like that off the Ruins Wall by candlelight. Lanternwright letters.

lyra-1w944pfr89p.speaker: lyra
lyra-1w944pfr89p.text: Wicks and ashes. Right. Breathe, Lyra.
lyra-1w944pfr89p.heard: Wicks and Ashes. Right. Breathe, Lyra.

lyra-1yesm7q5f13.speaker: lyra
lyra-1yesm7q5f13.text: Do that again. Slowly. Not at me.
lyra-1yesm7q5f13.heard: Do that again, slowly, not at me.

narrator-th3zutrlb1.speaker: narrator
narrator-th3zutrlb1.text: You open your hand before the altar, and the light comes.
narrator-th3zutrlb1.heard: You open your hand before the altar, and the light comes.

narrator-23wg2j3r7pr.speaker: narrator
narrator-23wg2j3r7pr.text: Thirty-eight flames stand up tall, every one, and bend toward you like flowers to a window.
narrator-23wg2j3r7pr.heard: Thirty -eight flames stand up tall, everyone, and bend toward you like flowers to a window.

aveline-i2cl4maqjk.speaker: aveline
aveline-i2cl4maqjk.text: There. I sat eighty-one nights wondering what they would do. Now I know, and I understand it less.
aveline-i2cl4maqjk.heard: There. I sat 81 nights wondering what they would do. Now I know, and I understand it less.

lyra-1vgqz34jl9y.speaker: lyra
lyra-1vgqz34jl9y.text: They've never done that for me. Not once. I'm not jealous. I'm a little jealous.
lyra-1vgqz34jl9y.heard: They've never done that for me. Not once. I'm not jealous. I'm a little jealous.

varek-2forv5u391x.speaker: varek
varek-2forv5u391x.text: That's far enough. The toll's paid at the fork, not up here.
varek-2forv5u391x.heard: That's far enough. The toll's paid at the fork, not up here.

lyra-1nb6e07n6v1.speaker: lyra
lyra-1nb6e07n6v1.text: He winds up before he swings. Watch his shoulders, and move.
lyra-1nb6e07n6v1.heard: He winds up before he swings. Watch his shoulders and move.

lyra-6l79ufdzfw.speaker: lyra
lyra-6l79ufdzfw.text: And nobody dies on this hill. Not even him.
lyra-6l79ufdzfw.heard: And nobody dies on this hill, not even him.

varek-t33ld41yss.speaker: varek
varek-t33ld41yss.text: Brave. Come on, then. Let's see what Hearthvale sends up a hill.
varek-t33ld41yss.heard: Brave. Come on, then. Let's see what Hearthvale sends up a hill.

narrator-5gan6o23qx.speaker: narrator
narrator-5gan6o23qx.text: The wood goes quiet. Then every wolf in Whisperwood answers one voice.
narrator-5gan6o23qx.heard: The wood goes quiet, then every wolf in Whisperwood answers one voice.

lyra-h1x2t61n37.speaker: lyra
lyra-h1x2t61n37.text: Greyjaw. Hess has been tracking him since spring. He's why the packs come so close.
lyra-h1x2t61n37.heard: Greyjaw. Hess has been tracking him since spring. He's why the packs come so close.

lyra-x7hnpj4chk.speaker: lyra
lyra-x7hnpj4chk.text: When he crouches, he's coming. Step aside, not back.
lyra-x7hnpj4chk.heard: When he crouches, he's coming. Step aside, not back.

narrator-fkxpk75crk.speaker: narrator
narrator-fkxpk75crk.text: In the deepest rain-pool something vast and pink stirs, and every little slime in the quarry turns to look at you.
narrator-fkxpk75crk.heard: In the deepest rain pool, something vast and pink stirs, and every little slime in the quarry turns to look at you.

lyra-10swecv3a62.speaker: lyra
lyra-10swecv3a62.text: That's not a slime. That's a lot of slimes that agreed on something.
lyra-10swecv3a62.heard: That's not a slime, that's a lot of slimes that agreed on something.

lyra-7lhz6xw1ve.speaker: lyra
lyra-7lhz6xw1ve.text: Hit it hard and it splits. Kill the little ones before it drinks them back.
lyra-7lhz6xw1ve.heard: Hit it hard and it splits. Kill the little ones before it drinks them back.

narrator-24nml7o4uv5.speaker: narrator
narrator-24nml7o4uv5.text: Mirror Lake goes still as glass. Then it hums, low, from somewhere under the boards.
narrator-24nml7o4uv5.heard: Mirror Lake goes still as glass, then it hums, low, from somewhere under the boards.

corran-5t2xwseuc8.speaker: corran
corran-5t2xwseuc8.text: Hm-hmm. Never heard her hum that loud. Mind the edges.
corran-5t2xwseuc8.heard: Hmm. Never heard her hum that loud. Mind the edges.

lyra-4ks4b5gc9t.speaker: lyra
lyra-4ks4b5gc9t.text: Still water that sits too long stirs. That's the old saying. Nobody said a whole lake.
lyra-4ks4b5gc9t.heard: Still water that sits too long stirs, that's the old saying, nobody set a whole lake.

lyra-4upa4gc5sb.speaker: lyra
lyra-4upa4gc5sb.text: It has to come up to hit us. When it does, so do we.
lyra-4upa4gc5sb.heard: It has to come up to hit us. When it does, so do we.

narrator-quvcm41fb5.speaker: narrator
narrator-quvcm41fb5.text: In the lower hall the cold light gathers into a lantern, and the lantern lifts.
narrator-quvcm41fb5.heard: In the lower hall, the cold light gathers into a lantern, and the lantern lifts.

lyra-1rx3vycbaox.speaker: lyra
lyra-1rx3vycbaox.text: Gravelight. Every Moot in the Lowmarch forbids it, and here it is, walking.
lyra-1rx3vycbaox.heard: Kreevelight. Every Moot in the lowmarch forbids it and here it is, walking.

lyra-1np6psoahwx.speaker: lyra
lyra-1np6psoahwx.text: That lantern, like the statue upstairs. Maren carried a miner's lantern in here. Hers burned yellow.
lyra-1np6psoahwx.heard: That lantern, like the statue upstairs? Maren carried a miner's lantern in here. Hers burned yellow.

lyra-42pz0nb5f.speaker: lyra
lyra-42pz0nb5f.text: Its shield won't take a plain cut. Hit it with something heavy, or with light.
lyra-42pz0nb5f.heard: Its shield won't take a plain cut. Hit it with something heavy or with light.
